about: Hand-set flight directions for upcoming launches whose direction Launch Library 2 does not give. Keyed by LL2 launch id. Each entry gives either azimuthDeg, or inclinationDeg with heading 'northeast', 'southeast' or 'both' (both draws the two possible paths). profile is optional (default falcon9-leo). How to find a direction, with URLs: reference/topics/cape-launch-azimuths-and-inclinations.md, section 'Runbook: finding the direction of an upcoming launch'. Remove an entry after the launch, or keep it as a record; it only applies to that launch id.

3b430f81-0ff1-4d85-8a1a-cef0de326198.heading: both
3b430f81-0ff1-4d85-8a1a-cef0de326198.source: Provisional. LL2 says 'mid-inclination orbit' (read 2026-10-15). SpaceNews reports SpaceX said Bandwagon missions go to inclinations of about 45 degrees (https://spacenews.com/spacex-to-offer-mid-inclination-smallsat-rideshare-launches/, read 2026-10-15); Bandwagon 3 went to 45 degrees (orbitcodex.com, secondary). Conflict: Wikipedia's October to December 2026 launch list gives SSO; the mission name and LL2 do not support that. Northeast or southeast not known yet: check where the drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas is the day before (off the Carolinas about 31.7 N 75.5 W means northeast; near the Bahamas about 25.3 N 75.8 W means southeast), then set heading.
